Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1155
Claimant:
Randall Duncan
Adjuster:
Darin Tyler
7-19-23
First notice of loss received for a side impact collision at an intersection involving two vehicles. The claimant is
represented by counsel, and the claim file has been opened for review.
8-11-23
Obatined the police report and statements from the other driver and two independent witnesses. All of them describe
the collision the same way, with the other vehicle entering the intersection and striking the driver's side.
8-31-23
Reviewed the photographs taken at the scene. The damage pattern is largely consistent with the impact described,
concentrated on the driver's side doors and rear quarter panel.
9-13-23
Confirmed through the police report and witness accounts that the claimant was in the vehicle at the time of the
crash. The driver is named on the policy and coverage was active on the loss date.
9-25-23
Reviewed the policy inception records and the vehicle's prior claim history. Nothing suggests the damage predates
the coverage period, and no earlier damage to the vehicle is on record.
9-28-23
Received the medical records from the claimant's counsel. The reported wrist fracture fits the kind of force expected
from a side impact of this type, and no prior injury to the same area appears in the records.
11-26-23
Reviewed the treatment timeline. Care followed a typical course, with treatment gradually reducing as the claimant's
condition improved and follow-up visits became less frequent.
12-16-23
Spoke with counsel regarding the claimant's account. The claimant has given the same description of the collision in
each conversation, and the account aligns with the statements already on file.
1-21-24
Reviewed the repair estimate against the photographs and the reported impact. The scope of repairs is mostly in line
with the described collision, and the estimate has been forwarded for internal review.
2-21-24
Updated the file with the current status of the injury and property components. Liability evaluation is progressing, and
the claim will be reassessed once the remaining medical bills are received.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
JSON format:
